header.title: Meta Assistant
header.subtitle: Your marketing partner: it knows your business, works in cycles and learns every day.

companion.label: Your Meta Assistant
companion.sleeping: Your assistant, asleep while you activate it

start.title: A marketing partner that learns from {business} every day
start.titleNoBusiness: A marketing partner that learns from your business every day
start.lead: Activate it in one click. It researches your market, builds campaigns, measures what works and starts again, always within the limits you set.

knows.title: Knows your business
knows.body: It starts from what Saleads already knows about {business} and grows it with every conversation.

loop.title: Works in cycles
loop.body: It researches, proposes a bet, launches it, measures and learns. Every round knows more.

limits.title: Within your limits
limits.body: You set how much it can spend on ads and creatives. Anything else, it asks you.

start.typePrefilled: We took it from what Saleads already knows. You can change it.
start.chooseTypeFirst: Choose what your business sells to activate it.
start.time: It takes a few minutes and you can keep using Saleads meanwhile.
start.terms: When you activate it, your assistant shares abstract lessons with Saleads from what you say or decide (never your data, figures or names) to create skills for businesses like yours.

preparing.title: Your assistant is waking up
preparing.lead: We're installing it in its own space, with access to {business}. It usually takes 3 to 5 minutes.
preparing.leave: You can leave this page: the dot next to «Meta Assistant» in the menu lights up when it's ready.
preparing.elapsed: {minutes, plural, =0 {Less than a minute so far} one {1 minute so far} other {# minutes so far}}

preparing_access.title: Connecting your account
preparing_access.body: It confirms it's you and that it can read your businesses in Saleads.

preparing_environment.title: Preparing its space
preparing_environment.body: We create a server of its own, just for your business.

installing_agent.title: Installing its team
installing_agent.body: The specialists who research, propose, measure and improve arrive.

configure_ai.title: Turning on its intelligence
configure_ai.body: We connect it to Saleads AI so it can talk with you.

slow.title: It's taking longer than usual
slow.body: It's still working. If it doesn't move in a few minutes, I'll show you how to retry.

stuck.title: It got stuck waiting for your account
stuck.body: The connection didn't come back. Retry: you won't lose anything that's already done.

failed.title: We couldn't finish setting it up
failed.body: Something failed while installing your assistant. Check again in a moment; if nothing changes, write to us through the support chat and we'll review it with you.

today.together: {days, plural, =0 {Today I start learning about {business}.} one {I've been learning about {business} for 1 day.} other {I've been learning about {business} for # days.}}

loop.title: Your assistant's cycle
loop.empty: The cycle starts when you tell it your marketing goal.

saleads.name: Saleads
saleads.body: Right here, with your whole business at hand

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp
whatsapp.prompt: I want to talk to you on WhatsApp. How do I link it?

instagram.name: Instagram
instagram.body: Let it answer your account's messages
instagram.prompt: I want you to answer my Instagram messages. How do I link it?

companion.name: Physical companion
companion.body: Your assistant, right by your desk

chat.title: Talk with your assistant
chat.empty: Tell it your marketing goal or ask about your sales, your campaigns or what to do this week.

suggestions.sales: How are my sales this week?
suggestions.goal: I want to sell more in December
suggestions.brain: What have you learned about my business?

chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
chat.tooLong: Your message is too long. Shorten it a bit to send it.
chat.disclaimer: Your assistant can make mistakes. Check what matters before publishing.
chat.historyError: We couldn't load the previous conversation.
chat.turnFailed: I couldn't finish your last message. Please try again.
chat.selectBusiness: Choose a business in Saleads to talk about it.

stopped.title: Your assistant is paused
stopped.body: It keeps what it learned and your conversations. Reactivate it whenever you want.

deleting.title: We're deleting your assistant
deleting.body: It takes a few minutes. When it's done you can activate a new one.

unavailable.title: Meta Assistant isn't available for your account yet
unavailable.body: We're turning it on in stages. When it's ready for you, it shows up here and in the menu.

help.title: How Meta Assistant works
help.lead: Your assistant works on its own, in rounds, always within the limits you set.

activate.title: You activate it once
activate.body: We prepare its own space with access to your business. It takes a few minutes.

loop.title: It works in cycles
loop.body: It researches your market, proposes a bet, builds the campaign, measures and improves. Every round stays in its brain.

limits.title: You set the limits
limits.body: Set how much it can spend on ads and creatives. Anything beyond that, it asks in «Needs your approval».

everywhere.title: It goes where you go
everywhere.body: It's the same assistant here, on WhatsApp, on Instagram and in your physical companion.

activityEmpty.title: No changes yet
activityEmpty.body: When I launch, adjust or pause something on Meta, it shows up here with the reason and whether it needed your approval.

today.title: Today
today.body: Here you see where I'm at with {business}. I work in rounds: I research, propose, build, measure and improve, and what I learn stays in my brain. I'm the same here, on WhatsApp, on Instagram and in your physical companion: what I learn in one place I know in all of them.

chat.title: Talk
chat.body: Ask me for whatever {business} needs: an idea, a campaign, how sales are going or a change. What you tell me, I learn too. Check anything important before publishing it, because I can make mistakes.

brain.title: My brain
brain.body: This is what I know about {business}. Every day I add what I learn from your sales, your ads and what you tell me.

limits.title: Your limits
limits.body: Inside these limits I work on my own at {business}. For anything else, I ask you first.

points.spend: I spread ad spend only up to the budget you approve
points.credits: I generate images and creatives only up to your credit cap
points.asks: Anything beyond that, I ask you first

activity.title: What I've done
activity.body: Every change I made at {business}, from newest to oldest. Tap one to see why I made it.

stock.title: Stock
stock.body: Here's what {business} has, what I counted and what's waiting for your confirmation. Nothing changes in your inventory until you approve it.

stock.title: Stock
stock.subtitle: What you have, what Jolly saw and what's waiting for your confirmation. Nothing changes in your inventory until you approve it.

current.caption: Stock by product and variant
current.note: Expected = last count + received − reported sales.

kits.label: Kits
kits.head: Kits: they have no units of their own, they come from their components
kits.reach: {count, plural, =1 {Enough for 1 kit} other {Enough for # kits}}

stock.unknownProposal: We couldn't find that proposal. It may already be resolved or expired.

blocks.effects: We can't show you what approving would do, so it can't be approved for now.
blocks.photoLost: You can't confirm this count because the photo was lost. Ask Jolly to count again.
blocks.photoRefreshing: Wait for the photo to load before confirming.
blocks.unsupported: This screen can't show this proposal yet, so it can't be approved here. Reload the page or ask Jolly.

count.photoLost: The photo is no longer available.
count.noPhotoVoice: No photo, you said it by voice
count.noPhotoChannel: No photo, it came through your channel

kit.incompleteCost: A component cost is missing: the margin isn't reliable yet.
kit.pendingPrice: The price is still to be defined.
kit.sourcesInChat: Sources and assumptions don't reach this screen yet. Ask Jolly for them before deciding.
kit.noSources: No sources: treat this as an assumption by Jolly.

receipt.caption: Invoice products
receipt.fixHint: Is something wrong? Reject it with the reason and Jolly will redo the proposal.

permission.effective: Even if you approve, at this stage Jolly stays at the “{level}” level.

autonomy.title: Jolly permissions
autonomy.body: What Jolly can do on its own in each area. You can lower a level anytime and, if an area is at “Learns”, bring it back to “Proposes”.
autonomy.lowerBody: {area} will move to “{level}”. Approved permissions for this area are revoked.
autonomy.raiseBody: {area} returns to “{level}”. Earlier permissions don't come back: Jolly would have to ask again.

dialog.changed: This proposal changed while you were reviewing it. Review the changes before deciding.
dialog.rejectEffect: No movement, order or kit is created.

notes.pedido: Approving authorizes negotiating within the ceiling. It doesn't pay anything.
notes.kit: Approving doesn't create any offer or launch ads.
notes.apuesta: Approving doesn't launch the campaign or spend. Launching stays on the web.

hints.share: Split the {total} units across the variants to confirm.

errors.gone: This proposal was already resolved or expired. We updated the list.
errors.stockNegative: There isn't enough stock for this. Count the product and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to decide.
errors.decision: We couldn't confirm your decision. Try again.
errors.invalid: This proposal can't be processed as it stands. Reject it and ask Jolly to redo it.
errors.invalidKit: This proposal can't be processed, for example if its products are in different currencies. Reject it and ask Jolly to redo it.
errors.levelChanged: This level changed while you were reviewing it. We refreshed the list: please check it again.
errors.levelInvalid: That level change is no longer allowed. Refresh the list and check it again.
errors.cancelGone: This order can't be cancelled anymore: it's no longer being negotiated. We refreshed the list.
errors.cancel: We couldn't confirm the cancellation. Please retry.

orders.title: {count} {product}
orders.receivedShort: {received} of {ordered} arrived: there is a difference.
orders.noPayment: No payment has been made yet.
orders.note: Savings only count once the goods arrive and are confirmed.
orders.cancelBody: {count} {product} with {supplier}. Jolly stops negotiating and the order is cancelled.
orders.cancelNotice: We don't notify the supplier: if you've already talked to them, let them know yourself.

items.title: There are no products in your inventory yet
items.body: Show your products to Jolly or send an invoice on WhatsApp. Each product shows up here once you confirm it.

proposals.title: You have nothing to approve
proposals.body: When Jolly counts something or proposes an order or a kit, you'll see it here before it happens.

orders.title: No orders yet
orders.body: Orders show up here when you approve a restock.

readError.title: We couldn't read your inventory
readError.body: Your stock didn't change. Try again in a moment; Jolly doesn't approve anything in the meantime.

partial.summary: We couldn't read the summary. Your stock didn't change.
partial.items: We couldn't update your stock. What you see may be out of date, and your stock didn't change.
partial.proposals: We couldn't update what you have to approve. Your stock didn't change.
partial.orders: We couldn't update your orders. Your stock didn't change.
partial.autonomy: We couldn't read Jolly's permissions. Your stock didn't change.

estratega.name: Strategist
estratega.about: Turns research into bets: who, which angle and which format.

estructurador.name: Builder
estructurador.about: Builds the campaign structure and its budget.

analista.name: Analyst
analista.about: Separates what the data backs from what still needs proof.

optimizador.name: Optimizer
optimizador.about: Proposes the next improvement, its risks and how to measure it.

landings.name: Landings
landings.about: Designs the page for each bet.

bodega.name: Warehouse
bodega.about: Counts your stock, reads invoices and proposes orders. Nothing changes without your OK.
